name: Coupons by country for WooCommerce
author: Dhrumil Kumbhani

sections.description:
Coupons by Country for WooCommerce is a powerful and lightweight WooCommerce extension that allows store owners to restrict coupon usage based on customer country.

If you run an international WooCommerce store, you may want to create country-specific promotions, regional discounts, or geographically targeted marketing campaigns. By default, WooCommerce does not allow country-based coupon restrictions. This plugin solves that limitation.

With this plugin, you can easily control which countries are eligible to use specific coupons — directly from the WooCommerce coupon settings page.

Perfect for global eCommerce businesses, region-specific campaigns, and stores offering localized promotions.

Why Restrict Coupons by Country?

Country-based coupon restrictions help you:

• Run region-specific marketing campaigns
• Offer localized discounts
• Prevent coupon misuse across regions
• Control promotional budgets
• Improve targeting and conversion rates
• Comply with regional pricing strategies

Whether you want to offer special discounts in the US, run a campaign only in Europe, or provide country-exclusive deals, this plugin makes it simple.

Key Features

Country-Based Coupon Restriction

Select one or multiple countries where the coupon will be valid.

Easy Integration with WooCommerce

Adds country restriction options directly inside the WooCommerce coupon settings.

Backend Country Selection

Simple dropdown country selector while creating or editing coupons.

Prevent Unauthorized Coupon Usage

Customers from non-selected countries will not be able to apply the coupon.

Supports WooCommerce Native Countries

Works seamlessly with WooCommerce billing and shipping country fields.

Lightweight & Performance Friendly

Clean code with no unnecessary overhead or performance impact.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Coupons.
  3. Create a new coupon or edit an existing one.
  4. Select the country (or countries) where the coupon should be valid.
  5. Save the coupon.

Now the coupon will only work for customers from the selected countries.

Use Cases

• Country-specific seasonal promotions
• Region-based discount campaigns
• International store pricing strategies
• Limited-time regional offers
• Exclusive country-based marketing campaigns
• Geo-targeted WooCommerce promotions

Benefits for WooCommerce Store Owners

• Better control over promotional campaigns
• Increased campaign effectiveness
• Improved ROI on discount strategies
• Reduced coupon abuse
• Better segmentation for international customers

Compatibility

• Works with the latest WooCommerce versions
• Compatible with latest WordPress releases
• Works with most WooCommerce themes
• Supports billing country validation
• Compatible with shipping country restrictions

Coupons by Country for WooCommerce is the perfect solution for store owners who want advanced coupon control without complex configuration.

Install today and take full control of your international WooCommerce promotions.
sections.installation:
Follow the instructions to install this plugin on your WordPress website.

Ex.

  1. Upload to the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Enjoy!
